explanation.tr:
Aile: parents, siblings (kardeşler), grandparents, uncle/aunt, cousin, nephew (erkek yeğen) / niece (kız yeğen), stepmother (üvey anne), in-laws (kayın aile), only child (tek çocuk).
İnsan tarifi:
• Görünüş: What does she LOOK LIKE? → She's tall and slim. She has long curly hair.
• Kişilik: What is she LIKE? → She's kind and generous.
• Sağlık/durum: How is she? → She's fine.
Sıfat sırası: opinion – size – age – shape – colour – origin: a nice tall young man, long straight black hair.
Kişilik sıfatları: generous ↔ mean, hard-working ↔ lazy, patient ↔ impatient, shy ↔ outgoing, honest, reliable (güvenilir), bossy.
Deyimler: take after (benzemek), look after (bakmak), get on with (iyi geçinmek), grow up (büyümek).
explanation.tk:
Maşgala: parents, siblings (doganlar), grandparents, uncle/aunt, cousin, nephew (ýegen oglan) / niece (ýegen gyz), stepmother (öweý ene), in-laws (gaýyn garyndaşlar), only child (ýeke çaga).
Adamy beýan etmek:
• Daşky görnüşi: What does she LOOK LIKE? → She's tall and slim. She has long curly hair.
• Häsiýeti: What is she LIKE? → She's kind and generous.
• Saglygy/ýagdaýy: How is she? → She's fine.
Sypatlaryň tertibi: pikir – ölçeg – ýaş – şekil – reňk – gelip çykyş: a nice tall young man, long straight black hair.
Häsiýet sypatlary: generous ↔ mean, hard-working ↔ lazy, patient ↔ impatient, shy ↔ outgoing, honest, reliable (ygtybarly), bossy.
Aňlatmalar: take after (meňzemek), look after (seretmek), get on with (gowy gatnaşmak), grow up (ulalmak).
explanation.ru:
Семья: parents, siblings (братья и сёстры), grandparents, uncle/aunt, cousin, nephew (племянник) / niece (племянница), stepmother (мачеха), in-laws (родня супруга), only child (единственный ребёнок).
Описание человека:
• Внешность: What does she LOOK LIKE? → She's tall and slim. She has long curly hair.
• Характер: What is she LIKE? → She's kind and generous.
• Самочувствие: How is she? → She's fine.
Порядок прилагательных: мнение – размер – возраст – форма – цвет – происхождение: a nice tall young man, long straight black hair.
Характер: generous ↔ mean, hard-working ↔ lazy, patient ↔ impatient, shy ↔ outgoing, honest, reliable (надёжный), bossy.
Фразовые глаголы: take after (быть похожим), look after (заботиться), get on with (ладить), grow up (вырасти).

explanation.tr:
1) -ed sonu üç şekilde okunur:
• /t/: sessiz seslerden sonra (p, k, s, ʃ, tʃ, f): stopped, looked, washed
• /d/: sesli ünsüz ve ünlülerden sonra: played, lived, cleaned
• /ɪd/: t ve d'den sonra: wanted, needed, decided
2) -s / -es sonu:
• /s/: p, t, k, f sonrası: cats, books
• /z/: diğer sesli sesler: dogs, plays
• /ɪz/: s, z, ʃ, tʃ, dʒ sonrası: buses, watches, pages
3) Vurgu (stress): iki heceli isim/sıfatlarda genelde 1. hece (TAble, HAPpy), fiillerde 2. hece (beGIN, deCIDE). Bazı kelimelerde vurgu anlamı değiştirir: a REcord (isim) / to reCORD (fiil), a PREsent / to preSENT.
4) -tion/-sion öncesindeki hece vurgulanır: inforMAtion, deCIsion.
explanation.tk:
1) -ed goşulmasy üç hili okalýar:
• /t/: sessiz seslerden soň (p, k, s, ʃ, tʃ, f): stopped, looked, washed
• /d/: sesli çekimsizlerden we çekimlilerden soň: played, lived, cleaned
• /ɪd/: t we d-den soň: wanted, needed, decided
2) -s / -es goşulmasy:
• /s/: p, t, k, f-den soň: cats, books
• /z/: beýleki sesli seslerden soň: dogs, plays
• /ɪz/: s, z, ʃ, tʃ, dʒ-den soň: buses, watches, pages
3) Basym (stress): iki bogunly at/sypatlarda adatça 1-nji bogun (TAble, HAPpy), işliklerde 2-nji bogun (beGIN, deCIDE). Käbir sözlerde basym manyny üýtgedýär: a REcord (at) / to reCORD (işlik), a PREsent / to preSENT.
4) -tion/-sion-dan öňki bogun basymly: inforMAtion, deCIsion.
explanation.ru:
1) Окончание -ed читается тремя способами:
• /t/: после глухих (p, k, s, ʃ, tʃ, f): stopped, looked, washed
• /d/: после звонких и гласных: played, lived, cleaned
• /ɪd/: после t и d: wanted, needed, decided
2) Окончание -s / -es:
• /s/: после p, t, k, f: cats, books
• /z/: после остальных звонких: dogs, plays
• /ɪz/: после s, z, ʃ, tʃ, dʒ: buses, watches, pages
3) Ударение: в двусложных сущ./прил. обычно на 1-м слоге (TAble, HAPpy), в глаголах — на 2-м (beGIN, deCIDE). Иногда ударение меняет смысл: a REcord (сущ.) / to reCORD (глагол), a PREsent / to preSENT.
4) Ударный слог — перед -tion/-sion: inforMAtion, deCIsion.

title: Tricky Spellings: Doubling, Silent Letters and Homophones

explanation.tr:
B1 düzeyinde sık yapılan yazım hataları:
• Uzun kelimelerde ikilenme: vurgu son hecedeyse ünsüz ikilenir: beGIN → beginning, preFER → preferred; vurgu sonda değilse ikilenmez: VISit → visited, LISten → listened
• Çift harfli zor kelimeler: accommodation, necessary, address, beginning, different, tomorrow, successful, recommend
• Okunmayan harfler: knife, write, island, Wednesday, receipt, foreign, doubt, listen
• Eş sesliler (homophones): weather/whether, there/their/they're, whose/who's, piece/peace, hear/here, quite/quiet (farklı ses!), advice (isim)/advise (fiil)
• -ible / -able: possible, visible / comfortable, available
explanation.tk:
B1 derejesinde köp goýberilýän ýazuw ýalňyşlyklary:
• Uzyn sözlerde iki esse ýazmak: basym soňky bogunda bolsa çekimsiz iki esse ýazylýar: beGIN → beginning, preFER → preferred; basym soňunda bolmasa iki esse ýazylmaýar: VISit → visited, LISten → listened
• Iki harply kyn sözler: accommodation, necessary, address, beginning, different, tomorrow, successful, recommend
• Okalmaýan harplar: knife, write, island, Wednesday, receipt, foreign, doubt, listen
• Deňsesli sözler (homophones): weather/whether, there/their/they're, whose/who's, piece/peace, hear/here, quite/quiet (sesi başga!), advice (at)/advise (işlik)
• -ible / -able: possible, visible / comfortable, available
explanation.ru:
Частые орфографические ошибки на уровне B1:
• Удвоение в длинных словах: если ударение на последнем слоге, согласная удваивается: beGIN → beginning, preFER → preferred; если нет — не удваивается: VISit → visited, LISten → listened
• Слова с двойными буквами: accommodation, necessary, address, beginning, different, tomorrow, successful, recommend
• Немые буквы: knife, write, island, Wednesday, receipt, foreign, doubt, listen
• Омофоны: weather/whether, there/their/they're, whose/who's, piece/peace, hear/here, quite/quiet (звучат по-разному!), advice (сущ.)/advise (глагол)
• -ible / -able: possible, visible / comfortable, available

explanation.tr:
Kelime aileleri: bir kökten farklı türler türetilir.
• succeed (fiil) → success (isim) → successful (sıfat) → successfully (zarf) → unsuccessful (zıt)
• create → creation → creative → creatively
• employ → employer / employee / employment → unemployed
Önekler anlamı değiştirir:
• re- (tekrar): rewrite, rebuild; mis- (yanlış): misunderstand, misspell; over- (fazla): oversleep, overcook; pre- (önce): preview; co- (birlikte): co-worker; ex- (eski): ex-wife
Sonekler türü değiştirir:
• İsim: -ness, -ment, -tion, -ity (possible → possibility), -ship (friendship), -hood (childhood)
• Sıfat: -ful, -less, -ous, -able, -ive, -al
• Fiil: -ise/-ize (modern → modernise), -en (short → shorten), -ify (simple → simplify)
explanation.tk:
Söz maşgalalary: bir kökden dürli görnüşler ýasalýar.
• succeed (işlik) → success (at) → successful (sypat) → successfully (hal) → unsuccessful (garşylykly)
• create → creation → creative → creatively
• employ → employer / employee / employment → unemployed
Öňgoşulmalar manyny üýtgedýär:
• re- (täzeden): rewrite, rebuild; mis- (nädogry): misunderstand, misspell; over- (artyk): oversleep, overcook; pre- (öň): preview; co- (bilelikde): co-worker; ex- (öňki): ex-wife
Goşulmalar söz toparyny üýtgedýär:
• At: -ness, -ment, -tion, -ity (possible → possibility), -ship (friendship), -hood (childhood)
• Sypat: -ful, -less, -ous, -able, -ive, -al
• Işlik: -ise/-ize (modern → modernise), -en (short → shorten), -ify (simple → simplify)
explanation.ru:
Словообразовательные гнёзда: от одного корня — разные части речи.
• succeed (глагол) → success (сущ.) → successful (прил.) → successfully (нар.) → unsuccessful (антоним)
• create → creation → creative → creatively
• employ → employer / employee / employment → unemployed
Приставки меняют смысл:
• re- (снова): rewrite, rebuild; mis- (неправильно): misunderstand, misspell; over- (слишком): oversleep, overcook; pre- (до): preview; co- (вместе): co-worker; ex- (бывший): ex-wife
Суффиксы меняют часть речи:
• Сущ.: -ness, -ment, -tion, -ity (possible → possibility), -ship (friendship), -hood (childhood)
• Прил.: -ful, -less, -ous, -able, -ive, -al
• Глагол: -ise/-ize (modern → modernise), -en (short → shorten), -ify (simple → simplify)

title: Work, Jobs and School: Key Collocations

explanation.tr:
İş:
• job (sayılabilir: a job) / work (sayılamaz: a lot of work) — 'a work' DEĞİL
• apply for a job (başvurmak), get/lose a job, be hired / be fired, earn a salary, work full-time / part-time, work overtime, retire (emekli olmak), be self-employed
• Meslek sorma: What do you do? → I'm a nurse. / I work as a nurse. / I work for a bank.
Okul:
• take/do an exam (sınava girmek), pass ↔ fail an exam, revise for an exam (BrE tekrar), get a good mark/grade
• attend classes, do homework, make progress, get a degree in…, primary/secondary school, university, subject (ders), timetable
• Dikkat: learn (öğrenmek) / teach (öğretmek); study (çalışmak, okumak)
explanation.tk:
Iş:
• job (sanalýan: a job) / work (sanalmaýan: a lot of work) — 'a work' DÄL
• apply for a job (ýüz tutmak), get/lose a job, be hired / be fired, earn a salary, work full-time / part-time, work overtime, retire (pensiýa çykmak), be self-employed
• Kärini soramak: What do you do? → I'm a nurse. / I work as a nurse. / I work for a bank.
Mekdep:
• take/do an exam (synaga girmek), pass ↔ fail an exam, revise for an exam (BrE gaýtalamak), get a good mark/grade
• attend classes, do homework, make progress, get a degree in…, primary/secondary school, university, subject (sapak), timetable
• Üns beriň: learn (öwrenmek) / teach (öwretmek); study (okamak)
explanation.ru:
Работа:
• job (исчисл.: a job) / work (неисчисл.: a lot of work) — НЕ 'a work'
• apply for a job (подавать заявку), get/lose a job, be hired / be fired, earn a salary, work full-time / part-time, work overtime, retire (выйти на пенсию), be self-employed
• Вопрос о профессии: What do you do? → I'm a nurse. / I work as a nurse. / I work for a bank.
Учёба:
• take/do an exam (сдавать экзамен), pass ↔ fail an exam, revise for an exam (BrE повторять), get a good mark/grade
• attend classes, do homework, make progress, get a degree in…, primary/secondary school, university, subject (предмет), timetable
• Внимание: learn (учить) / teach (учить кого-то); study (учиться, заниматься)
